name: slides
description: Headless presentation-deck SDK: author slides in Markdown or HTML, model themes/transitions/fragments/vertical stacks, serialize to JSON, and export a self-contained reveal.js HTML deck. Primary consumer surface is the headless SDK (".") plus a reveal.js React viewer ("./react"). The CLI/MCP/HTTP-serve/Postgres surface is deferred scaffolding, tracked here for a future release.

Headless deck SDK — createDeck/loadDeck, slide CRUD, JSON serialize, standalone HTML export.
exports../react: reveal.js-backed <Presentation>/<Deck> viewer (arrow-key nav, overview, fragments, notes).
